title: Chilled Chocolate Cashew Mousse
blurb: A rich, creamy mousse made from soaked cashews, dates and butternut squash, set in the fridge for a smooth chocolate dessert.
steps: Place the cashews in a bowl, cover with cold water and leave to soak for at least 2 hours or overnight, then drain well.
Put the dates in a small bowl, cover with warm water and soak for 15 minutes to soften, then drain.
Place the drained cashews, dates, butternut squash purée, cocoa powder, vanilla extract and water in a food processor or high-speed blender.
Blend on high speed for 2 to 3 minutes, stopping to scrape down the sides, until completely smooth and creamy.
Divide the mixture between six small glasses or ramekins.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours until firm and chilled before serving.
